tama-benton-cooperative.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 9 Tama Benton Cooperative locations, all of them in Iowa. The towns run from Cedar Rapids, Clutier and Dysart over to Muscatine, Shell Rock and Steamboat Rock. The table carries bids for corn and soybeans at each spot.

tettens-grain.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 12 Tettens Grain locations, 11 in Illinois and 1 in Iowa. The Illinois spots include Amboy, Annawan, Dixon, Galt, Harmon and Hennepin, and the lone Iowa location is Clinton. The table carries corn and soybeans at each one.

the-equity.story: As of Oct 17, the AGSIST network reads cash bids at 6 The Equity locations, all of them in Illinois. The towns on the list include Chrisman, Effingham, Martinsville, Strasburg, West Union and Westfield. The table carries corn and soybeans, and that is the whole lineup.

two-rivers-cooperative.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 3 Two Rivers Cooperative locations, all of them in Iowa. The towns are Monroe, Otley and Pella. The table carries bids for corn and soybeans at each one, pulled from the company's own bid site and rebuilt through the day.
